title: M19 — Break/fix 03: Promotion in the Wrong Overlay
description: A promotion of nginx:1.27 to stage didn't take — stage still runs 1.25 — while prod unexpectedly renders 1.27. The image pin landed in the wrong tier's overlay. Diagnose the two-sided symptom and move the pin to the layer that owns that promotion step.

steps.title: Move the pin to the right overlay and verify
